heading: Eligible financial institutions
lead: The Secretary may not guarantee under this subchapter a loan made by an entity not subject to examination and supervision by an agency of the United States or of a State.

notes.text: Amendments1991—Pub. L. 102–83 renumbered section 1847 of this title as this section. 1989—Pub. L. 101–237 substituted “Secretary” for “Administrator”.
